items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'Right' to the interviewer's statement that Glenn Miller had a band with Benny Goodman. The interviewee does not claim any personal interaction or relationship with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Harry James. He had the trombone player. He was in the Army and got lost in the plane. Glenn Miller he had. Ray Badu. Eddie Miller. Snappy Lamar. He had all of them.
Oh yeah, that old band he had with Benny Goodman and other.
